messages:
elena (sales): Quick heads-up — FinEdge wants a console view that correlates per-tenant cost with latency and quality metrics, plus drilldowns to example traces and an exportable chargeback CSV. Need for exec review in ~4 weeks.

samir (pm): Can you paste the ask from the AE thread? Is this a must-have vs nice-to-have for their renewal? :thinking_face:

elena (sales): From the AE: 'We need to show biz the cost vs latency tradeoffs for different models/routes, identify top cost drivers, and be able to export rows for finance to ingest. Drill-to-trace is critical so SREs can see bad requests.' Renewal not contingent but will accelerate procurement if present.

natalie (eng): Quick reality check: drill-to-trace requires linking request metadata to our trace ids. We have that for hosted but not fully wired for Dedicated customers. For MVP we can do hosted-only per-tenant; Dedicated would need a tiny agent or an API hook.

leon (solutions): FinEdge is on hosted right now. Good. They also want grouping by 'model family' and 'route' and ability to filter by date range and tag.

samir (pm): Proposed MVP (scope negotiation):
- Per-tenant dashboard card: daily cost (USD) + p50/p95 latency sparklines per-model/route
- Top-N cost contributors table (tenant, route, model, tokens, cost_usd) with a link 'View examples' -> opens traces for sample requests
- CSV export for displayed rows with columns: tenant_id, route, model, date, tokens, cost_usd, p95_latency_ms, example_trace_url
- Hosted-only for initial rollout

vikram (devex): UI notes: small card in Observability -> Telemetry that supports single-tenant view and a cross-tenant admin view (for finance). We should reuse existing sparkline component. CSV export should be endpoint-backed: GET /export/chargeback?params -> streams CSV.

natalie (eng): Backend work: cost attribution per-request already computed in billing pipeline, but we need join keys to map to traces and to surface example_trace_url. Estimate: 3 dev-weeks to add trace link + export endpoint, 1 dev-week for aggregation + perf testing.

samir (pm): Acceptance criteria for launch:
- Cost vs latency dashboard exists in Console and supports date range & model/route grouping
- CSV export contains all required columns and downloads within 10s for 30k rows
- 'View examples' opens a pane with 5 sample traces (hosted only) and links to full traces in Tracing UI
- UX sign-off from Sales + FinEdge PoC
- Feature flag gated and telemetry events emitted: telemetry.event=\"chargeback_export\"

elena (sales): FinEdge SLA: they'd like sample traces to show errors and high-latency tails — good to include p95 and sample error codes. They also want branding-free CSV for finance.

leon (solutions): For rollout: ship to hosted customers as opt-in beta, notify enterprise customers. Also create a template import mapping for finance teams.

natalie (eng): Performance concern: generating example_trace_url needs a small index of recent traces by request_id. We'll add a time-limited cache (TTL=7d) to avoid scanning traces.

infra-bot: Created ticket PROD-4827: "Chargeback CSV + Cost-Latency drilldown (hosted MVP)" assigned to natalie.

samir (pm): Next steps:
- I'll write short PRD with scope and launch criteria (due EOD tomorrow).
- natalie to scope infra work and confirm estimate by EOD Friday.
- vikram to mock a console card and small modal for traces by mid-next-week.
- elena/leon to collect FinEdge sample queries and finance CSV spec.

vikram (devex): Mock notes: keep card compact, show sparkline + small stacked bar for cost breakdown. Modal shows 5 rows with timestamp, latency, tokens, link. Will post Figma link in thread. :balloon:

samir (pm): Triage/Priority: P2 for backlog intake, but will expedite to P1 if FinEdge indicates procurement is conditional.

elena (sales): I'll push back with FinEdge and update thread if they make it conditional. Thanks everyone. :pray:

natalie (eng): Acked. I'll estimate and update PROD-4827.

samir (pm): Thanks — please add any constraints here. We'll review in Monday triage.
